title: Import the shared MockContentRepository fake instead of redeclaring it in epic_24_stop_bleeding_test.dart

evidence.quote: class MockContentRepository extends Mock implements ContentRepository {}
class MockContentRepository extends Mock implements ContentRepository {}

why: test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart:13 already defines the identical one-line MockContentRepository; this file re-declares it verbatim instead of importing it. Harmless today since mocktail scoping is per-file/per-library, but it's 1 of 11 files repo-wide carrying the exact same fork (checked via repo-wide grep, the other 10 are outside this batch) -- if ContentRepository's interface grows, updates to the shared fake won't reach files that forked their own copy, and a future author has no signal a shared version already exists.
recommendation: Import MockContentRepository from test/mocks/mock_repositories.dart instead of redeclaring it; flag the other 10 repo-wide duplicates for a follow-up consolidation pass (out of this batch's scope).
acceptance_criteria: epic_24_stop_bleeding_test.dart imports MockContentRepository rather than declaring its own class of that name
